findings.summary: No single declaration states Proposition B.8. The cone up to log x = −5, the exact field/pressure/five-row match and the propagation are separate theorems, held together only in NominalConeAssembly.Assembly and its existence proof.

The packaged ordered statement is existential in the activation transitions (for every ε some tolerance ≤ ε and some continuation witness work); the paper reads as all sufficiently small transitions. ∀ C ≥ C0 is kept.

On the restore/repair annulus Lean's intermediate margins differ from (B.36)–(B.37): a ≥ 3/5, v_s ≤ 1, normalized projection ≥ e^{-8}/2, floor R·e^{-8} ≥ 6. Same strategy and same conclusion; proof-internal, not a statement difference.

Clause (iii) for Q_s, N_s has no Controls-level statement. Equality of the lags with the reference outer profile is stated only for the final heat-completed Witness, and with the unheated reference only up to the heat patch clock.
